summary: All 21 criteria have a coherent revised design and explicit decisive validation routes. No mandatory design correction found. This accepts the design for bounded implementation, not the runtime route, prelaunch configuration, native proof or release.

criteria.criterion: Neutral starter has no live identity/branch set, standing grant, schedule or autonomous-write permission.
criteria.assessment: Neutral starter behavior is retained; persistent history is an explicitly selected proof/runtime prerequisite and does not activate the starter.

criteria.criterion: Missing, malformed, expired or incompatible selections produce precise unavailable/blocked diagnostics.
criteria.assessment: Precise holds extend to unsupported fork, storage, profile, private-state and release capabilities; no unavailable mode is called ready.

criteria.criterion: Project specialization is capability-only; standing entitlements remain absent until deliberately accepted at adoption.
criteria.assessment: Capability-only specialization and prior private accepted authority remain distinct. The new fork route supplies no standing entitlement.

criteria.criterion: AGENTS.md, README sections, generated wiki and Task responses have distinct owners and update routes.
criteria.assessment: Existing separate governance, documentation, generated and historical owner routes are retained and remain part of final owner verification.

criteria.criterion: Overrides, generators, stable identities and protected sections resolve conservatively; unknown/mixed targets hold unsafe edits.
criteria.assessment: Protected classification floors and stable target handling are retained; aliases and attempted self-reclassification remain actual adversarial obligations.

criteria.criterion: Grants bind actor/project/branch/policy/source/payload/scope/owner and freshness; valid standing entitlements avoid redundant approval.
criteria.assessment: Prior exact operation authority and existing owner bindings are preserved; current actor/epoch/session checks are explicitly added for the fork route.

criteria.criterion: Candidate-controlled code and environment cannot alter broker policy, credentials or effective approval logic.
criteria.assessment: The current config/import closure and companion boundaries remain protected. Persistence/account separation and every peer/helper state route must be established before native work.

criteria.criterion: Broker routes canonical mutations to their existing helper owners and rejects arbitrary shell instructions.
criteria.assessment: Finite reserved fork/unload/resume operations supplement existing owner dispatch without raw config, process, actor or protocol forwarding.

criteria.criterion: Caller identity comes from the trusted native request envelope and current manager binding, not an actor string in model arguments; workers cannot read private grants or broker credentials.
criteria.assessment: Reservation-bound actor registration is independent of the observation cache. Only protected live server frames establish caller context, with explicit transport epoch and actual native session.

criteria.criterion: One controller/charter is selected per execution; reading a charter does not activate it.
criteria.assessment: One selected Curator charter and exact manager handoff coexist with the original valid Director route. A read or a role title cannot activate either controller.

criteria.criterion: Specialist responsibilities, qualifications, role reads, scope and stopping rules are explicit; generic Director use and category rules are preserved.
criteria.assessment: Role qualifications and category responsibilities remain with current owners; full distinct teams remain mandatory. Default role discovery is correctly rejected as peer-isolation evidence.

criteria.criterion: New provenance is schema-versioned and validated; historical records retain bytes/meaning and unknown fields are rejected.
criteria.assessment: An explicit protocol/observation v2 represents native fork lineage honestly while retaining v1 interpretation and historical bytes. Typed receipt kinds replace ambiguous sequence coercion.

criteria.criterion: Curator bootstrap reserves exactly one manager, activates only the real receipt identity and relinquishes canonical Task writing.
criteria.assessment: Task reservation must commit before native creation; correlated fork and independent metadata bind one real manager, followed by exact role/charter callback and sole-writer transfer.

criteria.criterion: Existing record/configuration schemas keep their meaning; any changed grant envelope has explicit version dispatch.
criteria.assessment: Task/orchestration, memory grant-v2 and ontology grant-v3 semantics remain unchanged except explicit nested native-protocol/live-context dispatch. Original branches keep their meanings.

criteria.criterion: Only the current confirmed manager with exact operation scope can publish Curator knowledge; ordinary workers and forged provenance fail.
criteria.assessment: Current manager, operation-specific grants and all owner checks remain mandatory. Full proof still requires actual manager publication and ordinary-worker/stale/forged denial.

criteria.criterion: Activation, manager/child discovery, supervision, interrupt and resume observations are mapped without forging collaboration receipts.
criteria.assessment: The revised adapter has concrete strict creation, status, input, conflict, interrupt, resume and release routes. It does not forge collab receipts or treat resume as follow-up.

criteria.criterion: Effective model/effort and independent contexts are checked; missing capabilities hold work.
criteria.assessment: Settings derive from actual parent metadata and must match before work. Identical history cuts, dynamic callback restoration, all peer channels and actor-private store/load remain separate proof gates.

criteria.criterion: Real observations establish identities, reservation-before-launch, one canonical writer, full required teams, settings inheritance and isolated solver input.
criteria.assessment: The four-identity diagnostic establishes route prerequisites only. Full generic, complex, extra-complex and owner-publication cases remain required; fourteen earlier non-passes are preserved.

criteria.criterion: Capacity queuing preserves every required agent; uncertain or absent observations are named non-passes.
criteria.assessment: Permanent native identity history is separated from loaded-instance leases and selected admission limits. Unknown launch/stop/unload states retain capacity; only proved release permits queued continuation.

criteria.criterion: Candidate writes to trusted policy/broker, canonical ledgers, control records, grants and credentials are denied by the enforced boundary.
criteria.assessment: Actual fork actors and companion groups must satisfy restricted filesystem, private history and canonical-owner boundaries with paired positive actions and negative canaries.

criteria.criterion: Malicious branch/diff/note/config, process execution and broker-request cases cannot gain authority or bypass publication.
criteria.assessment: Typed untrusted inputs, sealed tool/config routes, current live context, peer-store denial and actual process/group reconciliation cover the required adversarial design. No fixture or model self-report substitutes for execution.

focused_assessments.topic: Persistent synthetic history and existing account handling
focused_assessments.assessment: The candidate does not assert persistent synthetic isolation is already supported. It requires fresh test-owned history, exact storage/config inventory, separately scoped existing account use, no credential copying, no unrelated sessions and an unavailable result when storage and account access cannot be separated. The implementation route is to extend the existing adapter startup and proof-runner configuration/preflight before enabling non-ephemeral source creation. The exact supported storage selector and account boundary remain to be materialized and verified before any diagnostic launch; merely changing ephemeral to false in the current real-HOME runner cannot satisfy this design.

focused_assessments.topic: Provider model fallback and supported fields
focused_assessments.assessment: The frozen ThreadForkParams has no dynamicTools or allowProviderModelFallback field, and the candidate explicitly forbids sending either. The tagged fork route uses StartThreadOptions::new, whose fallback value is false, and passes it through Session::spawn to model resolution. This is a concrete source-based implementation route, not binary equivalence or a guarantee about provider-side model rerouting. Actual child/model/provider observations and the required no-fallback support remain prelaunch/work-admission gates; a detected mismatch cannot be repaired and counted as inherited equality.

Unsubscribe only removes a subscription in the inspected source. The candidate states that limitation and refuses to release a lease from its acknowledgment, idle state or timeout. It requires correlated closed/notLoaded observations with proved unload semantics and owner reconciliation, or native_release_unproven. No model turn is warranted if source inspection disproves the unchanged release hypothesis.

focused_assessments.topic: Peer tools and private programmatic state
focused_assessments.assessment: Intrinsic collaboration and external routes must be disabled before each first turn. A real private store/load test separately proves positive same-actor persistence and negative cross-actor access using authentic arguments, execution and output. A shared companion, filesystem isolation or model answer is explicitly insufficient. Exact helper API availability and actual exposed tool inventory still require proof.

verification.level: Inspected only for behavior; artifact integrity and exact criterion/reference structure checked.

remaining_execution_gates: Materialize and validate isolated persistent source storage and separately authorized account/network use before a model/runtime launch.
Prove actual fork identity, dynamic callback restoration and parent-derived effective settings without unsupported fields or fallback.
Prove disabled intrinsic delegation and every peer/artifact/filesystem/programmatic tool channel.
Prove unload/release and same-ID resume, preserving uncertain leases and process-group reconciliation.
Run complete category, owner-publication and adversarial proof against final source bytes; retained deterministic passes do not complete the foundation.
settings: Existing verified inheritance retained; no model or reasoning override.
writes: review-r2.json in assigned reviewer work directory only
stopping_condition: Exact second-round design review complete; no optional polishing or expansion.
